wizard.title: New game from ROM

emptyRegion.title: Empty region with a starting town
emptyRegion.text: Only the starting town with the player’s house stays, the rest is an empty region. A start script gives you your first partner.

dataOnly.title: Data only
dataOnly.text: For balancing: stats, learnsets, trainers. Starts in the Pokémon area.

wizard.untested: There is no test project for this language. Unpacking works; editors and templates are not tested.
wizard.ownRom: Gen4 Studio ships no game data; you use your own ROM. The ROM stays unchanged.
wizard.templateHeading: What does the project start with?

summary.sentence: Creates “{{name}}” from {{game}} with the template {{template}}{{options}}, in {{dest}}.{{adopts}} The ROM stays unchanged.

wizard.noFolder: Choose a folder for the project.
wizard.textProject: Set up as a text project
wizard.textProjectHint: One readable file per entry, ready for Git; creating takes a little longer.
wizard.gitHint: Creates a local repository with a first commit; nothing is uploaded.
wizard.name: Name

done.title: Project created
done.nextDataOnly: Open starts in the Pokémon area.

drop.wizardOpen: Finish or cancel the wizard first.
drop.noPath: In browser mode the page does not know the file’s path. Type it in.

preview.format: The picture is neither PNG nor JPEG. Choose a PNG or JPEG file.
preview.tooLarge: The picture is too large (at most 32 MB and 8192 × 8192 pixels). Choose a smaller picture.
preview.unreadable: The picture cannot be read. Choose another file.
preview.other: The preview picture could not be changed. Check that the project folder is still there and that you may write in it.

clearWorld.title: Clear world
clearWorld.adoptFirst: For this the scripts must be adopted.
clearWorld.saveFirst: Save first, the recipe writes scripts straight to disk.
clearWorld.emptied_one: {{count}} place is emptied: its characters, doors, triggers and level scripts disappear. Scripts and texts stay.
clearWorld.emptied_other: {{count}} places are emptied: their characters, doors, triggers and level scripts disappear. Scripts and texts stay.
clearWorld.border_one: {{count}} cell of the world map becomes a locked border map.
clearWorld.border_other: {{count}} cells of the world map become a locked border map.
clearWorld.starter: A start script gives you {{species}} at level {{level}}, the Pokédex and the Running Shoes.
clearWorld.binary_one: {{count}} {{term}} could not be decompiled and stays binary.
clearWorld.binary_other: {{count}} {{term}} could not be decompiled and stay binary.
clearWorld.summary: Empties the world except {{town}}. You get the world back with ⌘Z; border map, level script and start script stay as files.
clearWorld.doneFiles: Border map {{border}}, level script {{level}}, start script {{file}} #{{n}}
clearWorld.doneNext: With “Play here”: intro, wake up at home, your first Pokémon waits outside.
